description.en: DeepSeek Harness 换肤插件（Dream Skin for DSH）：8 套 iOS / Linear 式清透冷调的高质感主题 + 弥散光壁纸 + 每皮肤智能背景 + 强调色 + 主题包分享，把换肤做成材质与配色克制的高级感工艺，而非贴图。Works in native DSH Web and third-party desktop clients (DSH Desktop): 8 original premium themes, glass materials, wallpaper 2.0, per-user accent, shareable theme packs — p…
DSH 远程目录（电脑端）：把本机 DSH 会话的事件流经 Cloudflare 隧道搬到手机，手机进入电脑目录并发起对话，公网只传文本。含激活码配对流程。
Automatic provider/model fallback chains for DeepSeek Harness agents when LLM requests keep failing (retry exhausted, auth, quota, rate limit)

自动识别 Steam 壁纸引擎（Wallpaper Engine，工坊 431960）里的壁纸并导入 DeepSeek Harness 作为背景：视频/网页/场景分别处理，内置 Relax Ambience [4K] 默认壁纸；支持鼠标滑动涟漪特效（WebGL 水面高度场、波峰扩散、折射壁纸 + 镜面高光，移植自 github.com/Yaki-Blake/mouse-ripple，上游 sirxemic/jquery.ripples，MIT）与性能显示。安装后需完全退出并重启 DSH，右下角的「壁纸」按钮才会出现；卸载时弹窗询问是否删除缓存（默认勾选）。

Live DeepSeek API token price bar for the web GUI: peak/off-peak tariff, UTC + local (Quebec) clocks, countdown to the next tariff change, and a daily self-verification against the official DeepSeek pricing page.

Plugin-authoring skill for DeepSeek Harness: the distilled anatomy, client-UI recipe, slots, locale, theme tokens, install steps, gotchas, and validation checklist for building and publishing new DSH plugins.
DSH 网页版桌面宠物「肥鲸」——蓝发鲸鱼娘，固定在 harness 页面右下角：会眨眼、能拖拽、点击可聊天，支持语音对话、念诗说书、饭点提醒。
A personal assistant connecting knowledge, research, and action for Pi, DeepSeek Harness, and Claude Code.
Computer Use 插件：虚拟鼠标真人操作 + 原生视觉模型接入（deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 直读截图），screen_observe 等 20 个模型友好工具；浏览器组 browser_* 为兜底
为 DeepSeek Harness 提供独立的图像生成与编辑 Skill、工具和设置界面。
在 DeepSeek Harness 对话中以会话级 artifact 安全展示交互式 HTML 可视化。
RDB durable session backend for DeepSeek Harness: implements both session-persistence and session-branch (rewind / retry / fork) providers.
Rewind / retry / recall / fork orchestration (host) plus the browser half — replaces the conversation.chat.node user / steering rendering and overrides the conversation.composer.dock stats row.
Cordis plugin: image/video backgrounds for DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop.
英语教练：判断水平、每天准备一课、碎片时间复习。
DeepSeek Harness pill that shows whether the selected DeepSeek or z.ai billing plan is in a peak or off-peak (half-price) window right now, with a click-to-open schedule panel.
A practical guide to DSH plugin quality: ENTRY checks, FLOW checks, and BOOST guidance. Community guide; not official, not a certification, not a ranking.
Aident CLI — umbrella access to Loadout integrations, Playbook automation, Intern tools, and the Aident platform.

AryaCode engineering bundle: one install surface for the Studio 5000 L5X, FactoryTalk View ME, MotionWorks IEC and FactoryTalk Optix surfaces, one row per product, with the ladder and display previews.
最小示例模块：装上后面板里多一张卡片，用来试装试卸。
Community plugin index data source for the dsh web ecosystem: community.json is the single source of the Workshop store plugin list and the dsh-market.com plugin manifest.

Community agent-preset manager: the Workshop's Presets panel and the host library that installs, declares, disables and uninstalls presets downloaded from dsh-market.com, keeping a downloaded composition inert until the plugin declares it to the agent-preset registry.

In-GUI skin center for the dsh web GUI — the single skin package: skins are pure asset directories (built-in plus $DSH_HOME/skins) loaded and rendered only by the skin center; live try-on and one-click apply switch atomically in the page (no reload, no cordis.patch.yml rewrite, no restart)
DataOps JWT intake and credential-backed MCP tools for managed DeepSeek Harness workspaces.
DeepSeek Harness Plus official-base Web distribution profile and ranged compatibility patchset
A2A protocol for DSH: expose a DSH Session as a standard A2A agent, call remote A2A agents, and run invite-only collaboration groups where a group is itself an A2A agent behind a gateway.

Host-level proactive wake-ups for DeepSeek Harness: let the model schedule its own alarms (once / interval / cron with random jitter), wake cold sessions on time, gate model-initiated follow-ups with quiet hours and a daily budget, and reclaim silent wake turns with tombstone compaction; ships a we…
ANP Identity management plugin for DeepSeek Harness
云端同步 0.4.4：enableTools 拆成 toolsMode（off/status/push/pull/all），用于定位工具注册序列化问题；默认 off。
Google Antigravity (agy CLI) models for DeepSeek Harness — stream Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS subscriptions into DSH with thinking, tool activity, token usage and in-GUI Google OAuth login.
DSH 远程目录（手机端）：在选文件夹流程里多出「电脑」页签，进入电脑目录、在电脑上发起对话，并把电脑的实时消息流同步到手机本地界面（只传文本，不映射桌面）。
Local model manager plugin for DeepSeek Harness: discover models, one-click configure, start/stop oMLX and llama.cpp, monitor memory and throughput, register into DSH.

Cut token cost without cutting model intelligence — a DeepSeek Harness (dsh) bundle plugin: structure-aware compression + TOON-style lossless encoding first + reversible spill-to-disk + real-time dashboard.
在 DeepSeek Harness 里看 A 股：盘面数据、个股分析、资金面、盘面直播、消息面。资金面含两融、44 板块多周期资金与个股全量下钻；个股支持四维评分与相似形态回测。仅数据展示与学习参考，不构成任何投资建议。
尽可能的使dsh适配竖屏等移动端设备
DeepSeek Harness bridge plugin: exposes the newest Zhipu/Z.AI coding-plan models (e.g. glm-5.3) on the zai-coding-cn route before the bundled pi-ai catalog catches up.
鲸编程 - 不只是手机遥控操作电脑,而是将电脑级的Agent能力装进手机

Monitor BI 报表工作室:左侧导航栏独立入口,点进去就是 Harness 原生对话,但该房间只做 Monitor BI 报表(上下文干净、不与日常对话混杂)。自带零安装 CLI 工具链、操作手册、模板、数据字典;首次使用自动询问连接信息。A clean, sidebar-entry BI-only room for DeepSeek Harness with bundled tools, manual, templates and dictionary.

Monitor 数据搬运工作室:左侧导航独立入口,把一个 Monitor 公司的数据(主数据/BOM/未结订单/库存快照/附加字段)经官方 API 搬进另一个 Monitor 系统,跨版本不动表结构/角色/权限。自带进程内引擎(源库直读+目标API写入)与操作手册。A sidebar-entry data transfer studio for DeepSeek Harness: moves one Monitor company into another via official APIs only.

Remote hassle-free access for DeepSeek Harness: a cloudflared quick tunnel plus a scannable QR code and settings shown in the Settings → Plugins page. Zero runtime dependencies, no database, no Firebase.
个人工作台：Agent 工作台（左栏 + 常驻对话 + 自研右侧数据面板）。

Thinking-loop guard for dsh: observes the llm/stream waterfall and breaks a model that degrades into a loop. Detects three per-call shapes (reasoning-only calls, restated-material calls, self-repeating low-entropy reasoning) and re-fires instead of latching; plus three mid-stream breakers that end …
Floating DeepSeek API balance badge for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, backed by the harness's own DEEPSEEK_API_KEY credential
DSH plugin: per-model proxy routing (http/https/socks5) with a settings UI — e.g. opencode/muse-spark-1.2-contributor needs a proxy while sibling models stay direct

DSH web 插件：通过 DSH v0.1.5-rc.1 原生第三方语言 API（locale.addLanguage + register(ns, locale, dict)）注册 19 种内置语言字典（ja/ko/fr/...），语言直接出现在 DSH 设置页原生 Language 行中切换，未覆盖文案按 fallback 链回退英文。 | DSH web plugin: registers 19 bundled third-language dictionaries (ja/ko/fr/...) through DSH v0.1.5-rc.1's native language-pa…
Active Context Pruning (ACP) for the DeepSeek Harness — model-driven context management as a CompactionEngine backend.
